#drums #practice-log

Not a drummer. Fergus Laidlaw says every guitarist should do ten minutes on a practice pad so they stop rushing fills, so here I am with an Evans RealFeel 12-inch pad and 7A sticks. His list for me, at a click of 80 BPM, eighth notes then sixteenths: single stroke roll, double stroke roll (RRLL, my left hand bounces like a wet sock), paradiddle RLRR LRLL, flam tap, and the drag. Week of 10 March 2025: paradiddles clean at 96 BPM, doubles fall apart above 84. He wants me to do accent patterns on the paradiddle so the accent moves around the bar. Feels like [[Guitar practice]] with less dignity, and the counting helps with the 12/8 song in the [[Setlist for open mic]]. Next step is the "Stick Control" book by George Lawrence Stone (1935), page 5, the first 24 exercises, 20 times each.
